# CHMReaderLight

A lightweight offline CHM reader and library for macOS.

## What It Does

CHMReaderLight helps macOS users collect local `.chm` manuals in a library-first workflow, then read them with a searchable table of contents, body search, reading history, zoom, text encoding controls, and safer defaults for unknown files.

It keeps source CHM files in place, stores only local library metadata and reading preferences, and is designed for local-only documentation reading rather than cloud sync or hosted document storage.

## Best For

- Managing legacy SDK manuals, vendor help files, Microsoft HTML Help archives, and offline API reference on macOS.
- Reading privacy-sensitive or internal documentation collections without uploading document content.
- Evaluating a focused CHM viewer with macOS menus, Finder integration, release artifacts, checksum files, and contributor-friendly docs.

## Trust Notes

- No telemetry, accounts, cloud sync, or hosted document storage.
- CHM-authored scripts are disabled, network access is blocked from rendered CHM content, and local resources are constrained to the extracted book.
- Release downloads are published on GitHub Releases with SHA-256 checksum files and GitHub artifact attestations for Apple Silicon and Intel Mac builds.
- Direct latest downloads are available for Apple Silicon and Intel Mac builds as `CHMReaderLight-mac-arm64.zip` and `CHMReaderLight-mac-x64.zip`.
- Homebrew is not a supported install path yet; the Homebrew Cask Guide is maintainer-facing preparation for a future cask.
- Installed app users can start from Help > Report or Request for question, install help, bug, compatibility, feature request, performance, accessibility, documentation, release feedback, showcase, and security-policy routes.
- Installed app users can use Help > Star on GitHub after a successful local workflow trial.
- Help > Copy Share Text creates bilingual sharing copy with release, star, feedback, and showcase links.
- Help > Release Feedback opens the release-feedback Discussion when release trust details are the blocker.
